fee_notes: Single fee of $49,900; waived for approved conversions. Existing franchisees pay $35,000 for 2nd+ stores. Employees pay $10,000. VetFran 20% discount; First Responder 10% discount. Multi-Unit Fee: $49,900 for first store + $35,000 per additional store.
raw_excerpt: You must pay PSP a lump sum initial franchise fee of $49,900 when you sign the Franchise Agreement
